entries.replacementFieldText: Apply only inside explicitly selected PRICE_1 and upholstery group SM at the exact OWN construction/runtime/asset SHA. Use one whole listed UPH tuple; CUPHSIDECOLOR is its actual coupled readonly side value, not a second colour menu. CMESHCOLOR has six actual choices on a separate measured group with disjoint canonical OWN selectors. The separate default PRICE_2/EGL/EGL01 and outside-prefix MESH controls are calibration states, not additional UPH choices. All30 actual source states and10 joint combinations were independently reconstructed; do not claim all cross-products were directly factory exported. Other PRICE/upholstery prefixes/constructions and the original full652/max662 scope remain unqualified. Different optimized receiving assets require an independent exact rebind proof.
